P3S_TOKEN.scope: stored OOF error reaggregation; no feature reconstruction or LOBO refit

limitations: Compact tables lack complete class_id/base_seed manifest: class-cluster inference and independent audit of class/seed or predecessor overlap are unavailable. Block IDs verify only within-panel subsets.
P2P compact tables identify W8/W4 cells but omit CFG metadata; CFG3 comes from the preserved protocol and audit rather than independent table filtering.

The compact tables do not contain all per-coordinate categorical marginals or terminal images: this analysis cannot independently recompute product-form h, LPIPS/DINO, or within-block rollout Monte Carlo error from first principles.
Block bootstrap assumes independent equally weighted class-seed blocks in these selected panels; it does not establish an ImageNet-wide or checkpoint-wide probability sample.
Conditional means have Monte Carlo error from 8 repeats in W8 primary, 4 in CFG1/W4, 2 in matched timing. Raw repeat-level variance is not recoverable from block means.
Matched compact files lack seed token and coordinate identity; execution-audit claims are not an independent raw identity verification.
Stored OOF MAE reaggregation does not retrain LOBO models or reconstruct original features. Descendant features are retrospective, not online inputs.
Coordinate TV is a mean of marginals, not the full coordinate distribution; fixed schedule, state, position, seed composition and remaining horizon co-vary.
Bonferroni family contains exactly six primary CFG3 W8 H/M_equal/R contrasts; it does not correct study-wide post-hoc selection.

method.label_to_seed: first 8 bytes SHA256(namespace + pipe + UTF-8 label), unsigned big endian
